changes.text: Local companions floating up into the canopy
details: Companions borrowed the player's vertical velocity and accepted platforms 16px overhead, so they ratcheted up steep slopes (firebog_05)
groundBeneath: nearest platform at or below the feet with a gentle 6px step up, else the lowest platform
Companions spawn at the player's level and idle-wander on their spawn platform

changes.text: Middleground colour applies to characters and items too
details: The client filters the whole middleground plane; Hell One's Glitches are greyscale like its decos (checked against a Naraka recording)

changes.text: Blurred backgrounds sliding with cut edges, and mirrored decos
details: Blurred layers bake into a texture covering their full bounds; cacheAsBitmap clipped the filter to the screen, so only the part visible at load was baked and its edges slid with parallax (firebog_05)
Restore h_flip on 58,268 decos the first import dropped; hidden decos start invisible

changes.text: Parallax layers, sky gradients, and layer colour from the source streets
details: build-street-layers.mjs restores each layer's canvas size, filtersNEW, and the sky gradient from the location XML
Background and foreground layers scroll with the client's parallax rule instead of sitting in world space off-screen
Layer colour uses the client's exact ColorMatrix (including its shifted tint row); blurred layers bake once at half resolution
